sections.content: How many people are "advertising and marketing associate professionals"?

145,810 people

were counted on the census as "advertising and marketing associate professionals" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Advertising and marketing associate professionals assist in the development and implementation of projects which aim to find out the preferences and requirements of consumers, businesses and other specified target groups, so that suppliers may meet these needs.

People who had this job were generally younger

The occupation of "advertising and marketing associate professionals" had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "advertising and marketing associate professionals", 24.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "advertising and marketing associate professionals" was 65 years or older.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "advertising and marketing associate professionals" included:

  • public relations professionals
  • bar and catering supervisors
  • dental nurses

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "advertising and marketing associate professionals" there were more women than men (62.5% compared with 37.5%).

This means "advertising and marketing associate professionals" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "business and public service associate professionals".

Men made up 37.5% and women made up 62.5% of "advertising and marketing associate professionals"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "advertising and marketing associate professionals" included:

  • biochemists and biomedical scientists
  • communication operators
  • interior designers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "advertising and marketing associate professionals" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "advertising and marketing associate professionals" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "advertising and marketing associate professionals", 8.5% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (76.1% compared with 23.9%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (85.4%) than self-employed (14.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Wandsworth, this is in the same region of London.
